basic_info.description: Inviting 2-BD, 1-BA flat w/parking in desirable Noe Valley. The property offers the convenience of a central and highly walkable location, but is also quiet and serene inside. Spacious living room w/large windows and natural light. Kitchen w/ample cabinet and counter space, newer appliances. Dining nook, large enough to fit a full-sized dining table. Both bedrooms have excellent closet space, with the back bedroom overlooking the garden. Side-by-side parking space shared with only one other unit w/E/V charger and additional storage space. Common laundry room with new W/D. Shared backyard is a sunny space to relax, garden, or entertain. Close to Noe's charming and lively commercial corridor on 24th St, plus also a handful of cafes, restaurants, and shops centered around Church and 29th Sts, and nearby Upper Noe Rec Center, featuring indoor and outdoor sports facilities and an off-leash dog run. The neighborhood's slow street, Sanchez, is just a block away. 95 Walk Score. Excellent access to public transit (the J Church Muni stops right across the street), tech shuttles, and easy freeway access.
